english.title: Drive a motor vehicle on a road with a child in a rear facing restraining device on front seat - air bag not deactivated
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, drove a motor vehicle , namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), whilst carrying a child seated in a rear-facing restraining device placed on a passenger seat protected by a front air bag, that air bag having not been deactivated
english.legislation: Contrary to section 15(1A) and (2) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 3 for meaning of "relevant vehicle".
(ii) See regulation 8 for meaning of seat belt to be worn.
(iii) This offence only applies for persons under the age of 14 years.
(iv) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(v) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied.
(vi) The Motor Vehicles (Wearing of Seat Belts) Regulations 1993 have been amended by the Motor Vehicles (Wearing of Seat Belts) (Amendment) Regulations 2006.
(vii) This offence does not apply to buses.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant without reasonable excuse, drove **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) whilst carrying a child seated in a rear-facing restraining device placed on a passenger seat protected by a front air bag, that air bag having not been deactivated.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale.

Fixed penalty ticket - One hundred pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
